Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application

package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application
The use cases: what an operator can do, expressed against the domain and the ports, with no knowledge of Swing, files, SQL or FFmpeg.

ManageGym changes the gym's structure, CaptureHighlight turns a button press into a stored highlight, BrowseArchive and ManageRecordings read and edit the archive, and OperatorAccess signs operators in and registers them. The read models (CourtView, HighlightView, ...) are what the window displays, so the window never holds a domain object.
